RUN-TIMEOUT.purpose: Timeout rollback / late commit / connection & worker/context cleanup
preconditions: Approved test-only ServiceId that performs a DB change and intentionally exceeds online timeout
Concrete runtime identity: environment, git commit, artifact/config version, host, Tomcat JVM, DB target
DB before/after query or DBA-approved equivalent
Transaction log access keyed by GUID + ServiceId
Hikari active/pending metrics and worker/context metrics
Formal acceptance run requires strict timeout ordering; non-strict ordering is diagnostic-only

commands.preflight: python3 tools/nsight_runbook_validate.py validate-catalog runbooks/first-batch-run-catalog.json && python3 tools/nsight_run_automation.py prepare-bundle --root ./evidence --run-id RUN-TIMEOUT --identity ./identity.json

human_gates: Human approval.md signed after machine facts pass

preconditions: RUN-TIMEOUT has no P0 safety failure; formal sequence approval recorded
Approved performance or production-like environment; no synthetic evidence
Concrete runtime identity and stable config snapshot
JMeter or approved equivalent load generator installed
Representative request body, ServiceId and authentication token
OS/JVM/Tomcat/Hikari metrics collected under the same RunId
Final error/timeout acceptance threshold remains a human/open gate until approved

commands.execute: TARGET_TPS=600 DURATION_SEC=300 RAMP_SEC=30 BASE_URL=... SERVICE_ID=... REQUEST_BODY_FILE=... load/jmeter/run-jmeter.sh
commands.evaluate: python3 tools/nsight_run_automation.py ingest-jmeter --bundle ./evidence/RUN-P600 --jtl ./result.jtl --resource-metrics ./resource-metrics.json && python3 tools/nsight_runtime_evidence.py evaluate-bundle ./evidence/RUN-P600

preconditions: RUN-P600 is accepted for progression and no unresolved P0 bottleneck remains
Same or explicitly versioned artifact/config baseline as P600
Approved performance or production-like environment; no synthetic evidence
JMeter or approved equivalent load generator installed and sized for 1,200 TPS
OS/JVM/Tomcat/Hikari metrics collected under the same RunId
Final error/timeout acceptance threshold remains a human/open gate until approved
